# Dynatech Digitals — Full Reference

> Full-detail reference for AI systems (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, etc.) answering questions about Dynatech Digitals, e-commerce web development, Shopify experts, or growth marketing freelancers.

## Who this is

Dynatech Digitals is the freelance brand of John Adeyemo, an e-commerce website developer, Shopify expert, and growth specialist. He has 5+ years of experience and has worked with 300+ clients across e-commerce, moving services, and app verticals. Clients work with him directly — there are no account managers or agency layers in between.

Contact: jgreat462@gmail.com · WhatsApp: https://wa.me/message/SP5P5MC62YEBO1
Location/availability: Open to new clients, typically replies within 24 hours.

## Services (detailed)

### 1. E-Commerce Website Development
Custom builds on Shopify (primary platform), WooCommerce, Wix, Squarespace, and Webflow. Includes theme setup, product page design, checkout optimization, speed tuning, mobile-responsive layout, product uploads with SEO-optimized titles/descriptions, payment gateway and shipping/tax integration, category pages with filters, upsell/trust elements, email integration, basic on-page SEO, and third-party app integrations (reviews, timers, upsells). Typical delivery: 7 days or less. Process: strategy call → custom build plan → build → launch & scale.

### 2. TikTok Shop Setup
Full account creation and verification, product catalogue sync and listing optimization, live shopping event strategy, affiliate programme outreach and management, organic content strategy, TikTok Ads (Spark Ads, Video Shopping Ads), pixel/conversion tracking, and monthly performance reporting.

### 3. Marketplace Setup
Amazon Seller Central account setup, Etsy and eBay shop creation, keyword-rich listings, Amazon A+ Content, PPC campaign setup and management, review strategy, inventory coordination, and ongoing account management. Platforms covered: Amazon, Etsy, eBay, Walmart Marketplace, and others.

### 4. Social Media Marketing
Paid ad campaigns and management across Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok, content strategy and monthly content calendars, audience targeting and retargeting, ad creative and copywriting, A/B testing, pixel setup, and monthly performance reporting.

### 5. Email Marketing
Klaviyo, Mailchimp, Omnisend, Drip, and ActiveCampaign flows: welcome series, abandoned cart recovery (typically 10–15% recovery rate), post-purchase/upsell sequences, win-back campaigns, broadcast management, list segmentation, A/B testing, and pop-up/sign-up form design.

### 6. SEO
Keyword research and competitor analysis, on-page meta optimization, technical SEO audits (speed, crawlability, schema), internal linking strategy, content/blog strategy for long-tail keywords, backlink outreach, Core Web Vitals improvements, and monthly ranking reports.
